name: io.github.woodcoal/searchhub
title: SearchHub
description: Aggregate Serper, Tavily, Exa and AnySearch behind one resilient search API. Rotates provider keys automatically, fails over between providers, opens a circuit after repeated failures, and enforces per-key daily/monthly/total quotas and QPS limits.

environmentVariables.name: SEARCHHUB_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Directory holding store.json, settings.json and logs. Defaults to ~/.search-hub. Set this if you keep provider keys somewhere other than the default location.

environmentVariables.name: SEARCHHUB_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Master key used to decrypt stored provider keys. Must match the value that was in effect when the keys were saved.
